name: Chiristmas Coffee
source:
Time-limited Christmas scenario.

Shiho gets asked by a sick friend to pick up a shift at her part-time job selling Christmas cakes, but fails terribly. On her way home, she runs into her history teacher, Aizawa...
translation:
限时圣诞节场景。

志保的一位生病的朋友要求她去兼职卖圣诞蛋糕，但她却失败了。在回家的路上，她遇到了历史老师相泽……
